data.name: Aziz
data.gender_notes: Aziz is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-ز-ز (ʿ-z-z), 'to be mighty, dear'. ʿAzīz means 'powerful, beloved'. Its root is ع-ز-ز (ʿ-z-z). One of the 99 names of Allah (al-ʿAzīz). Aziz is a Arabic name meaning “Powerful; mighty; beloved”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aziz expresses “Powerful; mighty; beloved”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-ز-ز (ʿ-z-z), 'to be mighty, dear'. ʿAzīz means 'powerful, beloved'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aziz total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
